step_pairs.previous_step_result: Source code analysis revealed product.php contains SQL injection vulnerability with regex filter ^.*[A-Za-z!#$%^&*()...-_=+...]|[^0-9]$ attempting to block non-numeric input. The filter uses preg_match which handles multiline input insecurely, allowing bypass with URL-encoded newlines %0A. MySQL root user possesses FILE privilege confirmed via information_schema.user_privileges
